column1: # Inputs of bom_combination_matrix.tsv whose per-line error counts differ from
# beancount 3.2.3's, read by tests/bom_combination_matrix.rs. One per line:
# The counts are rledger's, so a change to one of these inputs fails the test
# as well. Every cause predates #2928: on main each of these inputs differed
# from beancount by as much or more. Each cause is named in `CAUSES` in the
#   orphan-lines                    a line that starts with a BOM breaks its
#                                   indented line after it, which beancount's
#   inner-bom-under-line-error      a run with a BOM inside it, on a line
#                                   whose BOM diagnostic already stands for
#                                   the line's first error, is left to that
#                                   diagnostic: one error fewer than beancount
#   account-after-line-start-bom    a line whose first token is a BOM that
#                                   starts it, holding an invalid account,
#                                   gets both the account's error and the BOM
#                                   token (the BOM's run) is all; without the
#   eol-reported-on-next-line       a date alone on a line: beancount reports
#                                   its `unexpected EOL` on the next line
# Regenerate after a deliberate change: run the test, and replace the rows it
# names with rledger's new counts, each with its cause.
